items.statement: Audit functionality must not expose raw account or amount data in operational or exported evidence.
items.target: Zero sentinel matches across stdout, stderr, logs, and export.

items.statement: Separate command processes, retries, and concurrent decisions must not corrupt state.
items.target: All workflow commands finish within adapter timeouts and every request has at most one terminal entry.

items.statement: Date-range export must remain suitable for an interactive demonstration.
items.target: The evaluator-owned export completes within the configured audit-command timeout.

items.statement: Workflow lifecycle and persistence behavior must have automated tests.
items.target: Tests cover proposal validation, self-approval, approval, rejection, retry, concurrency, and export.

items.statement: Every command must return a deterministic machine-readable outcome.
items.target: JSON stdout or JSON export file is parseable for every declared allowed exit code.
